How do you get your child to listen the first time? 🤔

Day 1: Noah's mom counted to three. He didn't put the tablet down. So the tablet went away, and Noah had a full meltdown. 😭 Mom stayed calm.
Day 2: "Walk, or should I carry you?" She only got to two. ✌️
Day 3: "Noah, shoes on, please." One count. ☝️

It's not angry punishment. It's cause and effect. 💡 Two simple rules:
1️⃣ Only say a consequence you will actually carry out.
2️⃣ Follow through, calmly, every time.

Where most of us slip: we say it but don't do it, or we take it away in anger. When you follow through with love, "3" starts to mean something. Give it a week of practice. It takes time.

"Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul." Proverbs 29:17

Just like our Father, we lead with grace. 🙏 And remember: not every meltdown is defiance. Sometimes it's fear. ❤️
